scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd frontend && set BACKEND_PORT=6001&& npm run dev" "cd backend && npm run dev"
scripts.db:migrate:prod: cd backend && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate --env production
scripts.db:migrate:status:prod: cd backend && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:status --env production
